title: Sing Hallelujah to the Lord
lyrics_original: [Men] Sing, Christ is risen from the dead!
[Ladies] Sing, Christ is risen from the dead!
[Men] Sing, Christ is risen from the dead!
[Men] Sing, Christ is risen, sing, Christ is risen,
Sing Christ is risen from the dead!
[Men] Jesus is reigning as the King!
[Ladies] Jesus is reigning as the King!
[Men] Jesus is reigning as the King!
[Men] Jesus is reigning, Jesus is reigning!
Jesus is reigning as the King!
[Men] Sing, Christ is coming for His own.
[Ladies] Sing, Christ is coming for His own.
[Men] Sing, Christ is coming for His own.
[Men] Sing, Christ is coming! Sing, Christ is coming!
Sing, Christ is coming for His own!

bible_verses.english: Let everything that has breath praise Yahweh! Praise Yahweh!
Praise Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, my soul!
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation! Power! and glory belong to our God:”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, my heart longs to lift a pure song of praise to You today. Thank You for Your incredible goodness, Your mercy, and the salvation I have in Jesus Christ. As I sing "Hallelujah," quiet the noise around me and fill my soul with Your abiding peace. May my life, both in quiet moments and in bold song, bring glory and honor to Your holy name.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, my heart longs to lift a pure song of praise to You today. Thank You for Your incredible goodness, Your mercy, and the salvation I have in Jesus Christ. As I sing "Hallelujah," quiet the noise around me and fill my soul with Your abiding peace. May my life, both in quiet moments and in bold song, bring glory and honor to Your holy name.
devotional.reflection_english: This simple yet profound hymn calls believers together to offer pure, unhurried praise to our God. "Hallelujah" is the timeless cry of a grateful heart, acknowledging the Lord's majesty, grace, and unfailing love. As voices weave together in harmony, we are reminded that our praise connects us to the eternal song of heaven. Today, take a quiet moment to lift your heart and offer Him the sincere adoration He so richly deserves.
